x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
mn = 1e9
a, b = 0, 0

def gcdLL(a, b):
    from math import gcd
    return a * b // gcd(a, b)

for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    l = gcdLL(int(y), i)
    ip = int(x * (l // int(y)))
    if ip % (l // i) == 0:
        ip //= (l // i)
    else:
        vok = float(ip)
        pop = float(l // i)
        vok = (vok / pop) + 0.49
        ip = int(vok)
    ip2 = ip
    if mn > abs(x / y - ip2 / float(i)):
        mn = abs(x / y - ip2 / float(i))
        a = ip2
        b = i

d = gcdLL(a, b)
a //= d
b //= d
print(f"{a}/{b}")
